subject: Annual prepay plan + staged collection run-through (FluxFin)
messages:

Subject: Re: Annual prepay — target cadence and VAT routing?

Hi Kimberly + team,

Thanks for the quick call earlier. To follow up, FluxFin wants to land an annual prepay (USD 360k) for next fiscal year but prefers a staged invoice cadence tied to milestone acceptance so our treasury can manage cash. Our constraints:
- We need 60-day PO validity from signature.
- We require invoice-level VAT evidence for EU-subsystems (FluxFin EU entity will reclaim VAT).
- Preferred payment rails: ACH (US), SEPA (EU) — please include bank remit details on invoices.

Can you propose a specific invoice schedule and an example of the drawdown tracker we’d receive? Also attach any PO template we should use.

Attachments: FluxFin_PO_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,
Julie
Senior Procurement Manager, FluxFin
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Julie Choi <julie.choi@fluxfin.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — target cadence and VAT routing?

Julie — thanks for the details and for the PO template. Attached is a proposed schedule (RI_PrePay_Schedule_v1.pdf) and a sample drawdown ledger. High level proposal:

Proposal summary (annual commitment USD 360,000):
- Invoice 1 (Activation): 50% = USD 180,000 — issued at contract signature (T+0).
- Invoice 2 (Mid-year tranche): 25% = USD 90,000 — issued 6 months after signature, contingent on usage > 50% of monthly expected tokens for prior quarter.
- Invoice 3 (Year-end true-up): 25% = USD 90,000 — issued at 12 months with usage reconciliation; any additional usage billed overage at standard rates.

Drawdown / collection mechanics (what we’ll deliver to you weekly):
- Weekly drawdown CSV with invoice mapping, token burn by route and model, open credits, and remaining committed balance.
- Threshold releases: if committed balance falls below 20% of starting prepay, automation emails the FluxFin payments alias and triggers PO reminder.
- Bank remit fields included on every invoice (ACH and SEPA options).

VAT & tax notes: 
- For EU-taxable flows, we will include per-invoice VAT summary and attach the VAT_Evidence_Instructions.docx for FluxFin EU reclaim process. We can route EU invoices to FluxFin Netherlands entity as requested.
- We will mark tax point/date on every invoice and include the model of evidence (signed delivery confirmation + usage report).

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm PO validity window and whether you want invoice 2 to be conditional on milestone vs fixed-date.
2) We’ll generate a DocuSign for the activation invoice and send a sample drawdown CSV schema for your treasury to test with.

Attachments: RI_PrePay_Schedule_v1.pdf, VAT_Evidence_Instructions.docx

Thanks — kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference

Looping in a couple operational clarifications from my side — small asks so treasury can reconcile: 

Operational clarifications (Priyom):
- We will include a line-level reference on invoices: DEAL=DL-2028-7839 and a unique invoice code (RI-INV-YYYYMMDD-XXXX). Please ensure your AP team accepts that format for automated posting.
- For the mid-year tranche: recommend fixed-date (6 months after signature) rather than usage gate to simplify your internal approvals. If FluxFin prefers milestone gating we can support but will need SLA language for verification windows (10 business days review).
- VAT evidence: we can accept a self-attested VAT reclaim form + local VAT registration number. If FluxFin wants Redwood to reverse-charge, we need the EU VAT ID and confirmation from your tax counsel.

Action needed from FluxFin: please confirm whether mid-year tranche should be calendar-based (2029-03-14) or usage-gated. Also confirm the remit entity for EU invoices and the VAT ID you want on the invoice header.

On attachments: I’ll upload a sample drawdown CSV to the HubSpot deal once Kimberly confirms.

—Priyom

Julie / team — thanks, this all looks good. Quick confirmation from Redwood leadership side:

- We accept FluxFin’s requested 60-day PO validity.
- We’ll issue Invoice 1 on signature (50%). Invoice 2 will be fixed-date (2029-03-14) per Priyom’s suggestion — easier for AP. Invoice 3 true-up at 12 months.
- We’ll include DEAL=DL-2028-7839 and the RI invoice code on all invoices.
- Expected processing timeline: once Invoice 1 is issued and DocuSigned, FluxFin payment window is net 30 (standard) unless you confirm net 45.

Julie — can you confirm (1) remit entity for EU VAT, (2) whether FluxFin will accept net 30 on activation invoice, and (3) final PO file so we can generate the DocuSign? Once you confirm, Kimberly/priyom and I will produce the activation invoice and the sample drawdown CSV.

Thanks — Marcus
